title: jq command not available in agent environment
description: The agent environment does not have the 'jq' JSON parsing utility installed, which is commonly expected in environments that work with JSON APIs.
symptoms: Agent had to work around missing jq by using curl without JSON parsing
root_cause_hint: The Docker image or agent environment setup does not include jq in the base installation
relevant_files: Dockerfile or agent environment setup scripts
evidence: Exit code 127: /bin/bash: line 1: jq: command not found
